nodes.title: Every Plivo-facing control-plane route checks X-Plivo-Signature-V3 (or Ma-V3 with the main token) over the PUBLIC URL Plivo was given (VP_PUBLIC_URL + path + query), with each nonce accepted once (plivo_nonce, pruned after a day); no token or no public URL answers 503, never open
nodes.rationale: Staging sits behind Caddy basic auth that Plivo cannot pass; the bypassed carrier paths need their own proof. The algorithm is Plivo's SDK's (plivo-python signature_v3.py read 2026-10-24); the docs page's examples are inconsistent, so the SDK is the reference and its transcription generates the test vectors both services test against.
nodes.reverse_if: the first live callback fails the check (then log the base string Plivo's request implies, compare with the SDK, and fix the reconstruction; never disable the check), or Plivo publishes a V4

nodes.title: tests/plivo-signature.test.ts 3/3 (6 SDK vectors reproduced byte for byte; changed parameter, host, nonce or token refused; rotation list and Ma-V3 accepted; on the speak route: public URL behind a proxy accepted once, replay, unsigned, forged, upstream-URL-signed, tampered refused, no token 503) and numbers-kyc speak test signed
nodes.method: node:test against Postgres 16; vectors from scripts/plivo-v3-vectors.py (transcription of the SDK, no install)
